safetyNotes: Print PRT-02 (Doublet Lens Barrel) in matte black PLA+ to eliminate internal stray light reflections along the optical axis.
Print PRT-04 (LED Ring Diffuser) in natural/white translucent PETG with 2 perimeter walls and 15% lightning infill for uniform specimen illumination.

steps.title: Step 1: Install Universal iPhone Camera Alignment Saddle
steps.note: Slide-on smartphone saddle with M26×1.5mm optical turret thread centered over the primary camera lens. Registers the optical axis of the doublet barrel directly over the iPhone main camera.
steps.description: Slide-on smartphone saddle with M26×1.5mm optical turret thread centered over the primary camera lens. Registers the optical axis of the doublet barrel directly over the iPhone main camera.

steps.title: Step 2: Install Threaded 100× Achromatic Doublet Lens Barrel & 12mm Focal Length Achromatic Glass Doublet Macro Lens (100×)
steps.note: Baffled cylindrical optical cell with snap-fit retaining lip for the 18mm OD 100× achromatic doublet. Holds OTS-01 glass doublet lens coaxial with the iPhone camera and threads into PRT-01.
steps.description: Baffled cylindrical optical cell with snap-fit retaining lip for the 18mm OD 100× achromatic doublet. Holds OTS-01 glass doublet lens coaxial with the iPhone camera and threads into PRT-01.

steps.title: Step 3: Install Snap-Fit Warm White Coaxial LED Diffuser Ring & 5V Warm-White SMD2835 Coaxial Microscope LED Ring + USB Dimmer
steps.note: Translucent annular housing that snaps around the lens barrel and diffuses the 5V SMD LED ring. Provides shadow-free ring illumination across opaque and translucent specimens.
steps.description: Translucent annular housing that snaps around the lens barrel and diffuses the 5V SMD LED ring. Provides shadow-free ring illumination across opaque and translucent specimens.

steps.title: Step 4: Install Fine-Pitch Dovetail Z-Focus & XY Slide Stage & M3×40mm Fine-Pitch Brass Thumbscrew, Anti-Backlash Spring & Nut
steps.note: 60° dovetail focus carriage with 25×75mm slide recess, bottom condenser aperture, and M3 leadscrew bore. Translates the microscope slide smoothly along the Z-axis for crisp 100× focusing.
steps.description: 60° dovetail focus carriage with 25×75mm slide recess, bottom condenser aperture, and M3 leadscrew bore. Translates the microscope slide smoothly along the Z-axis for crisp 100× focusing.

steps.title: Step 5: Install 25×75mm Borosilicate Microscope Slides, Coverslips & Stage Clips
steps.note: Standard 1mm-thick ground-edge 25×75mm glass microscope slides with #1.5 coverslips. Holds biological or material specimens flat in the focal plane of PRT-03.
steps.description: Standard 1mm-thick ground-edge 25×75mm glass microscope slides with #1.5 coverslips. Holds biological or material specimens flat in the focal plane of PRT-03.
